title: Easily Forgotten
text:
Easily Forgotten. Sure, these are really cute and add color to your kitchen.

However, if you actually use your kitchen and walk over these, the color will quickly fade, and you will throw it out.

I didn't buy it from Amazon, but I wanted to warn you!

Forget this item, or any items that look like this!
